annotations.title: Is your site ready for AI?

description: A free check of whether AI assistants and search engines can read a website: AI crawlers allowed in robots.txt (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot and others), no noindex, text readable without JavaScript, structured data, title and description, canonical, one H1, Open Graph, llms.txt and a sitemap. Returns a score out of 100, the checklist and the three most important fixes. Reads only public files from that site; the address is not stored. Use it when someone asks whether their site is visible to ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity or AI search.

url.description: The website to check, e.g. https://example.com (the homepage works best).
